positions.title: Software Engineering Manager/Software Engineer Lead
positions.description:
• Recruited, built, and developed a high-performing engineering organization by hiring 8 developers and 2 QAengineers. Created a structured onboarding and mentorship program that reduced ramp-up time and enabled rapidteam productivity. Drove talent development through regular coaching, bi-weekly 1:1s, annual performanceevaluations, career planning, and Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs), fostering a culture of continuous learning,accountability, and high performance.
• Reduced on call production response time to 2-5 minutes through strategic system health monitoring andimplemented blue-green deployment pipelines, enabling flexible daytime releases and improved teamproductivity.
• Leading migration of in-house VM-deployed applications to the PaaS platform Mia, driving significant cost savingson on-premise VM infrastructure.
• Initiate and facilitate Tech Talks & Knowledge Sharing sessions, breaking down knowledge silos and fosteringcollaboration. This increased predictable deliverables by 20%, achieving 75% on-time completion.
• Develop MyQueueRSS, a high-performance single-page application features(C#, REST API, Angular, RxJS, Redux).This replaced slow CRM-based loan opportunity tracking, providing real-time loan file context and follow-up tasks.
• Integrated with AI-powered call transcription API deployed in Amazon ECS with Fargate behind ApplicationLoad Balancer for high availability speech-to-text conversion, using Lang Chain framework with OpenAI LLM forintelligent summarization, SQS recording events for asynchronous messaging, and S3 for storage, enabling loanofficers to give insights into previous calls.
• Improvement in code quality by implementing the standard around end-to-end regression test, unit andfunctional testing. Performed code reviews and developed and reviewed test scenarios in collaboration with QA team.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on Java, Spring, Big data technologies like Spark, Hadoop to support legacy systems, develop new tools and software. Worked with 6-8 engineers in an Agile environment with TDD and pair programming to write, debug and unit test code. Worked collaboratively with remote teams to ensure successful sprint outcomes.

⇒Car Damage Severity System:
•Analyzed part vs estimate sources, came up with list of usable data for features and created training data.•Implemented Java-Spark applications to generate parquet files from source and sanitize data.•Used Spark-ML (Logistic Regression) machine learning model to normalize data and generate prediction for predefined categories.Evaluated model output using Dremio. Researched Amazon sage maker to deploy model into the cloud.•Configured Jenkins projects to build and release project.

⇒UCL (Recommendations Notification Engine):
•Spiked out features of Spark (RDD, UDFs, DataFrames) and implemented them using TDD in Java.•Implemented a daily ETL process using Spark to connect to MySQL to extract data, transform and load them intoparquet files on a HDFS Hadoop cluster.•Implemented an application using Amazon SDK and BetterCloud vault to pull data from S3 bucket.•Wrote Java-Spark app to generate recommendation emails and Http Client to send requests with email data.•Created Control-M workflow to automate process from end to end.

⇒Migration of Archive Documents from OpenVMS to MongoDB:
•Worked on Spring Boot app to send messages onto Rabbit MQ.
•Used Spring Batch app to ftp binary and ascii files from OpenVMS filesystem into MongoDB GridFS using springremote file template.
•Containerize the project using Docker.

projects.title: Project # PDX-NHIN - Enterprise Pharmacy System
projects.description:
The Enterprise Pharmacy System Workflow technology is for high volume independent pharmacies and as well as for chains.  This system divides the prescription processing tasks into stations/states that can be assigned to members best qualified for the tasks. EPS Pharmacy System offers a wide range of functions, such as basic prescription filling, third party claim submissions and reconciliation, integrated ePharmacy Web engine, IVR, drug inventory interfaces, Extensive use of images (prescriptions, drugs) for a paperless workflow and quick and easy product verification, Easy-to-use, intuitive user interface, and thorough reporting.    

The system is Java-based application that uses an embedded Oracle database on each store server. It is a distributed system where each store has a UNIX server and several clients attached. It is connected to the EHR database and to the Host application for file maintenance, reporting and NHIN AR services.       

It is integrated with the Rx.com Electronic Healthcare Record database, which provides connectivity to a chain-wide set of centralized patient records including patient demographic, address, allergy, third party and prescription information. The central database supports address standardization and patient matching and merging logic.
